name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-yojana (PM-MKSSY): COMPONENT 1A: Formalization of Fisheries Sector and Facilitating Access of Fisheries Microenterprises to Government of India Programs for Working Capital Financing
briefDescription: The scheme aims to formalise fisheries microenterprises and facilitate their access to institutional working capital finance through small grants and credit intermediaries.
descriptionMd: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-yojana (PM-MKSSY): Component 1A is designed to formalise the fisheries sector. It focuses on empowering fisheries microenterprises by facilitating their access to institutional working capital financing. This is achieved through the provision of small grants and by connecting them with credit intermediaries.
benefitsMd:
- Formalization of fisheries microenterprises
- Facilitated access to institutional working capital finance
- Provision of small grants
- Access to credit intermediaries
eligibilityMd:
- Be a stakeholder in the fisheries sector.
- Be registered on NFDP (National Fisheries Development Portal).
- Have verifiable credit needs.
- Possess valid bank accounts.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
